subject: Request: Exceptional POC Top-up + Runway Extension for ClearSight
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearsight.ai>, Emily Chen <emily@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Exceptional POC Top-up + Runway Extension for ClearSight

Hi Oliver / Emily,

Thanks again for the productive proof-of-concept week — the team is already seeing promising results with the Redwood runtime on your ingestion pipeline. Based on the dashboard and your feedback, ClearSight has a concrete pilot milestone: integrating Redwood embeddings into your anomaly-detection scoring pipeline (goal: 10% lift in precision on low-frequency anomalies).

We have two asks to keep momentum and get to a meaningful integration:
- One-time credit top-up: additional 300k tokens of hosted API credits to complete the integration and stress tests.
- Runway extension: extend the PLG evaluation window by an extra 21 days beyond the standard 30-day trial (i.e., total 51 days) to accommodate your security review and a weekend of end-to-end validation.

Why this is justified:
- Current usage shows they consumed ~420k tokens during functional testing; remaining integration + load tests estimate ~240–320k tokens (attached usage snapshot).
- The engineering team requires the extra time due to scheduling constraints with their SREs and a third-party data vendor.
- ClearSight is evaluating Dedicated later in H1 if the integration meets SLAs; this is a clear expansion path.

Attached: clearsight_usage_snapshot_Q4.csv, mutual_action_plan_v3.pdf

Ask: I need Deal Desk / Exec signoff for the one-time credit top-up and the extra 21 days. If approved, I will: 1) apply the credits immediately, 2) update the MAP, and 3) schedule a checkpoint for Jan 4 to review integration artifacts.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with finance/legal if helpful.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exceptional POC Top-up + Runway Extension for ClearSight

Jasmine —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions before we route to Aditya for exec approval:
1) Is the 300k tokens above and beyond any credits already committed for this trial? Please confirm net uplift.
2) Are there any contract/term deviations (billing, data residency, or uptime SLA) the customer is requesting in exchange for the top-up?
3) Please provide a brief ROI line we can include in the approval memo (value trigger for the deal post POC).

If you can answer inline, we'll aim to have a decision by EOD.

- Deal Desk

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 12:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exceptional POC Top-up + Runway Extension for ClearSight

Hi Deal Desk — answers below and an approval recommendation: 

1) Net uplift: Yes — this is a one-time, additional 300k token credit on top of the standard PLG 50k token trial they already consumed. So net additional tokens requested = 300k.

2) Terms: No unusual contract terms requested. ClearSight wants the standard trial terms. They did ask for a short nonbinding note that the credits are a one-time gesture contingent on completion of the MAP. No SLA changes requested.

3) ROI / expansion signal (short):
- ClearSight has a prioritized roadmap item tied to anomaly precision that translates to ~ $450k incremental ARR if the model integration reduces false positives by 10% (conservative internal projection from their product lead).
- Probability of expansion given a successful integration: 45–60% over 6 months based on prior mid-market conversions.

Recommendation: Approve a conditional grant of 200k tokens + a 14-day runway extension (not the full 300k / 21 days requested). Conditions:
- Credits applied as one-off, non-recurring, and expire at the extended trial end date.
- ClearSight must complete the MAP checkpoint and provide the integration test report by Jan 4, 2028.
- Account team to provide a short summary of outcomes and next-step motion to Sales Ops within 72 hours of checkpoint.

Rationale for conservative ask: we want to balance runway with precedent (we've had similar expansion pilots lose momentum when we over-extended credits). Marcus and I reviewed the usage snapshot and the 200k should be sufficient for integration + load tests if they prioritize.

I can route to Aditya for formal signoff if you think this is acceptable.

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exceptional POC Top-up + Runway Extension for ClearSight

Team —

I reviewed Jasmine's note, the usage snapshot, and Marcus's comments. I approve a one-time grant of 200,000 hosted API token credits and a 14-day extension to the trial window, effective immediately. Conditions to document in the approval memo:
- Credits are non-recurring and expire at trial end.
- ClearSight must complete the MAP checkpoint and deliver the integration test report by 2028-01-04.
- The account team (Jasmine / Marcus) will submit a 1-page outcome memo to Sales Ops and Finance within 72 hours of the checkpoint.
- If the customer requests further credits or term changes, escalate back to me with the outcome memo and updated usage metrics.

Jasmine — please coordinate with Deal Desk to apply the credits and update HubSpot / the MAP. Marcus — please own the outcome memo process.

Thanks — Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
